description: This file defines the internal class SiloInstanceRecord, which models a record of a silo instance in a distributed Orleans cluster. It includes properties for silo attributes, methods for serialization/deserialization, and utilities for key construction and parsing.

classes.name: SiloInstanceRecord
classes.description: Models a record of a silo instance with properties for its attributes and methods for encoding and decoding from DynamoDB attributes.

methods.name: SiloInstanceRecord
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty record.

methods.name: SiloInstanceRecord
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a record from DynamoDB item attributes.

methods.name: UnpackRowKey
methods.description: Parses a DynamoDB row key string into a SiloAddress object.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the silo instance record.

methods.name: ConstructSiloIdentity
methods.description: Creates a unique silo identity string from a SiloAddress.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Returns the DynamoDB key attributes for this record.

methods.name: GetFields
methods.description: Returns the DynamoDB attribute fields representing this record.
